content_of_post_to_comment: My daughter asked me last week what I actually do at work. I opened my mouth to explain project management and nothing came out. I ended up saying, "I make sure people who don't talk to each other still get the same information." She said, "So you're like a group chat, but a person." I've been trying to come up with a better description for six years. She nailed it in one sentence.
